code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob, helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper}, framework/schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil, resources/{cron-schedules-prod.properties, application-prod.properties, application-uat.properties}. Other repos: not used. The old copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ is ignored (stale)
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark: Vault & SMS Code Split, SMS permission for the App Service may need to be checked (cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck. This is the hirer version of OCMS12.9: the batch SMS sender to Postman2 via APIM (max 1000 per batch) is the same for every reminder stage, so an individual hirer at last stage DN2 is included with template DN2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL[_COMBINED]. Gaps: (1) cron.notification.enabled=false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:236 and in prod sms.enable=false with no sms.allowedSources (application-prod.properties:87; sms.allowedSources=ENOTIFICATION exists only in dev and UAT), so SmsUtil refuses to send; (2) the number refresh from DataHive/DOS is off (cron.enareminder.datahive=false); (3) combining per hirer uses the key ID + stage + due date, so one hirer with different due dates gets more than one SMS; (4) the DN2_SMS_* template text lives in the DB and cannot be confirmed to mention the outstanding notices and the 2nd letter. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Vault and SMS permission cannot be verified from repo. Ticket: OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed; waits for the eNotification cron to be active).
recommendation: Claim partially. The batch SMS code for an individual hirer at DN2 exists, but the eNotification job is off, SMS is refused by sms.enable=false in prod, and the DOS refresh is off. Ask URA to confirm activation of the eNotification cron and SMS in PRD and the content of template DN2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL

steps.step: OCMS uses the latest mobile number of the individual hirer from DOS (DataHive)
steps.detail: The job calls refreshContactInfo per record (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-188). For an individual refreshIndividualContactInfo reads the Singpass contact from DataHive and saves the new number to owner_driver (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710). But every refresh only runs when cron.enareminder.datahive = 'true' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:92-93 and 2461-2485) and the value is false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:48 (also dev and UAT). So in the repo configuration the stored number is used, not a number from DOS. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo; the real server value cannot be verified from repo.

steps.step: OCMS identifies the unique individual hirers in each batch job so one hirer gets one SMS
steps.detail: combineNotices merges notices per recipient key I_<ID> + stage + due date, sums amount_payable and fills combinedNotices (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2151-2227; getRecipientKey :2230-2247; called from NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:191), so DN2 notices of one hirer with the same due date become one SMS (template *_COMBINED). Sebagian because the key contains the due date: one hirer with notices of different due dates receives more than one SMS, and combining only happens inside one job run.

steps.step: The SMS lists the outstanding notice(s) and refers to the 2nd letter reminder/notification
steps.detail: For reminders, nextProcessingStage is filled with the last stage (DN2) (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:174-180), so determineTemplateName yields DN2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL or DN2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL_COMBINED (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:301 and 456-476). generateMessages loads the template from the DB and prepareTemplateData fills in the notice data (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:274-305 and 410-437); if the template is missing the SMS is skipped with an error log. The template text lives in ocms_template_store (DB), not in the repo: whether it lists the outstanding notices and refers to the 2nd letter cannot be verified from repo.

steps.step: OCMS sends the SMS reminder/notification to the individual hirer in the batch job
steps.detail: The job sends through sendBatchSms -> SmsUtil.sendBatchSmsSimple with source ENOTIFICATION (Postman2 via APIM, max 1000 per batch; NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:289-292; NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1527-1545 and 1611-1612); companies are skipped because they only receive email. Sebagian because (1) cron.notification.enabled=false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:236 (the scheduler skips execution, NotificationJobsScheduler.java:30-31 and 49-52); (2) in prod sms.enable=false (application-prod.properties:87) and there is no sms.allowedSources in prod (only dev and UAT: application-dev.properties:85, application-uat.properties:82), so SmsUtil refuses with status 'disabled' (SmsUtil.java:401-410). The real server values, the Postman2 gateway and the SMS permission for the App Service: cannot verify from repo.
